clips.title: The story
paras: Besseleth's Fang is the massive venomous tooth harvested from the giant spider Besseleth in Sishir Canyon. Carried as proof of her demise, it represents the removal of a deadly threat stalking the trails of Stonetalon Mountains.

Sishir Canyon has long been infested by aggressive arachnids, but none strike more terror into travelers than Besseleth. Growing to monstrous proportions, she and her brood turned the gorge into a death trap for wanderers navigating the Webwinder Path at night. The fang itself measures nearly two feet in length and drips with potent venom, making it an unmistakable signature of the broodmother's slaughter. Presenting this grisly trophy brings relief to local defenders who have suffered her venomous strikes.
